gloss: to respect; to honor; to revere

definitions.explanation: To hold someone in high esteem and show deference.
To regard with deep respect, often with religious or spiritual connotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}う。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}う⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't forget your feelings of respect for your teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}い、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{祈|いの}っている→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: He reveres God and prays every day.

notes:
{敬|うやま}う is transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}). It takes を for the person being respected.

ASPECT ({ている}):
{敬|うやま}っている indicates an ongoing state of respecting someone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {年上|としうえ}を{敬|うやま}う (to respect elders)
- {先生|せんせい}を{敬|うやま}う (to respect one's teacher)
- {神|かみ}を{敬|うやま}う (to revere God)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～を{敬|うやま}う: The person being respected

RELATED WORDS:
- {尊敬|そんけい}する: To respect (more common in everyday speech)
- {敬意|けいい}: Respect (noun)
- {敬語|けいご}: Honorific language

Register: Somewhat formal/literary. {尊敬|そんけい}する is more commonly used in everyday conversation. {敬|うやま}う has a more traditional, reverent nuance.
